open_points.subject: 00_product.md:Decisions: Decisions
open_points.text: the owner refuses a name that breaks the rule before it is written
open_points.question: When the owner declines the paused room-add request, what observable outcome does Kernel give the run and agent: does the node fail and end the run, is the run cancelled, or may the request be corrected and resubmitted, while guaranteeing that Registry receives no write?
options: The node fails and the run ends with a refusal visible to the agent and owner.
The run is cancelled with no Registry call.
The run remains paused so the request can be corrected and resubmitted.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the declined approval as a terminal refused node, make no Registry call, and show the refusal to the owner and agent.

witness.initial: An agent run reaches an add-room node without standing approval, with a room name that breaks the writer rule; Registry has not been called.
events: Cabinet Kernel shows the exact request and room name to the owner.
outcomes: Kernel ends the node and run as refused, with no Registry write.
Kernel keeps the run pending or permits a corrected request to continue from the same node, with no Registry write yet.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent observing the run
